picks.editorial_note: MIT's Regina Barzilay and Jim Collins won the 2026 Pritzker Prize for AI in Science Research Excellence for pioneering AI-enabled antibiotic discovery — one of the field's most prestigious honors, validating years of deep-learning-driven drug discovery work.
picks.title: Regina Barzilay and Jim Collins win Pritzker Prize for AI and Science Research Excellence for work in AI-enabled antibiotic discovery

picks.editorial_note: A Cambridge-led AI-guided 'plug and play' technique produced a broad-spectrum bird flu vaccine with complete protection against diverse variants in animal trials, a major step toward pandemic-ready vaccine design.
picks.title: Scientists are using AI to develop superior vaccines against viruses threatening global health

picks.editorial_note: University of Nebraska-Lincoln will lead cybersecurity for FabAID, a five-year, $24.5 million NSF-funded national infrastructure project for AI-driven science led by the Morgridge Institute.
picks.title: University to lead cybersecurity for national Fabric for AI-Driven Science project

picks.editorial_note: HKUST and HSBC signed a strategic framework agreement anchoring HSBC's new AI & Emerging Technology Institute, deepening a near three-decade academia-finance partnership around AI innovation.
picks.title: HKUST and HSBC Forge Strategic Partnership to Advance AI, Emerging Technologies and Financial Innovation
picks.university: Hong Kong Univ. of Science and Technology

picks.editorial_note: Boston University joined a $39.5 million ARPA-H-funded consortium with Philips, Johns Hopkins, and Weill Cornell to develop AI-enabled robotic catheter technology for remote stroke intervention.
picks.title: Brink Bites: Robotic Stroke Surgery, Curbing Junk Food Sales, and American Attitudes On Data Center Construction

picks.editorial_note: A Case Western Reserve-led, NIH-funded multi-institutional team will combine large-scale health data, satellite imaging, and AI to study how environmental exposures contribute to Alzheimer's and dementia.
picks.title: Case Western Reserve-led team to study how the environment contributes to Alzheimer’s and dementia | CWRU Newsroom | Case Western Reserve University

picks.editorial_note: The DOE's release of 'Genesis Agent Skills,' with Fermilab building agentic AI tools for scientific ML workflows, marks a concrete step in the national Genesis Mission's push to accelerate AI-driven research infrastructure.
picks.title: ‘Genesis Agent Skills’ release to support innovation across the Genesis Mission

picks.editorial_note: Tel Aviv University and Stanford researchers showed AI models can learn general predictive skills from purely self-generated synthetic data rather than real-world data, a potentially foundational shift in how models are trained.
picks.title: AI Learns to Predict the World Without Ever Seeing It

picks.editorial_note: ANU secured Google.org funding to modernize a widely used fusion simulation tool with AI, pairing a major tech funder with fusion energy research.
picks.title: ANU receives Google funding to boost fusion energy research with AI

picks.editorial_note: A Georgetown economist's analysis of SpaceX and Anthropic's massive equity giveaways — including Anthropic's pledge of up to $100 billion in shares — raises significant questions about how AI-driven wealth will be distributed and governed.
picks.title: Billions in SpaceX, Anthropic Stock Pledged to the Public. Who Benefits? - Georgetown University
